title: 1970: New Orders panel falling behind Orders List

issues.title: New Orders panel falling behind Orders List
issues.body:
I'm in the real game (`yarn develop`), in `P9 Test`, playing as `Blue`, `Mar-1`.

I'm in the Planning Channel, with the `My Orders` tab open.

When I expand the `New Message` panel at the bottom of the `Support Panel`, the new-message box sits behind the table of orders.

It should either sit in front of the table, or take space away from the table.  Hmm, I think taking space from the table is best, so that players can still view the other Orders items.

![Screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/58fdf8631273d9a89cffaba0c911fd15.gif)
